summary.name: Trend Micro Ad Blocker
summary.one_liner: A free Safari ad blocker for Mac, from Trend Micro (sold under the Cleaner One Pro brand), that blocks ads, pop-ups and trackers.
use_cases: Stop ads and pop-ups while browsing in Safari on a Mac
Speed up loading of web pages
Block trackers that follow browsing behavior
Hide unwanted parts of a web page without breaking its layout
Allow ads on specific sites you trust
summary.what_it_does: The tool blocks online ads and pop-ups in Safari so websites load faster and use less memory, according to the page. It can hide undesirable parts of a web page without disrupting the layout. It lets you keep showing ads on websites you trust. The page also says it blocks apps from tracking browsing behavior and sending sensitive personal information. Support is offered by email at mac_support@trendmicro.com.
notable: Listed as 'Free ad blocker for Safari' in the awesome-mac list
Can hide page elements without changing overall layout
Lets you whitelist sites that keep showing ads
Bundled with the Cleaner One Pro Mac cleaner brand
caveats: Page describes Safari use; Chrome is mentioned only in the meta description, not on the page itself
